messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout for release v1.8.3 (dynamic-routing + prompt-cache changes). Canaries going out now to shard-a (10 instances). /deploy link: https://ci.redwood/release/v1.8.3 :rocket:
maya: Heads up — feature flag new_prompt_cache should stay OFF for prod until we confirm rate-limits. I'll watch errors.
devon: Acknowledged. Ramp plan proposed: 0% -> 1% (canary) -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. 15m observation at each step.
sre_jordan: Adding SLO watchdog: auto-pause if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p95 latency increase > 30%. We'll surface alerts to #eng-oncall.
maya: Also request pinning model-version to v2.1.4 for canary traffic — avoid the new v2.2 rollout until after 25%.
devon: Command I ran for canary flag toggle: `ffctl set --env prod --flag new_prompt_cache --pct 1 --target shard-a`
deploy-bot: Canary reached 1% on shard-a (10 instances). Observing metrics.
sre_jordan: Seeing a small uptick in p95 on shard-a (+12ms), within thresholds. No errors.
maya: Good. Proceed to 5% in 10m unless any change. Release notes: https://internal.docs/releases/v1.8.3.md (summary included).
release-eng: FYI we've added a rollback playbook in the release notes. Rollback triggers: error spike >1% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 200ms.
devon: Initiating 5% ramp now: `ffctl set --env prod --flag new_prompt_cache --pct 5`
ops-bot: Metric check: rate limit breaches detected on shard-b during previous deploys. Suggest adding rate-limit guard: `rlctl --enable prompt_cache_guard`.
sre_jordan: At 5% we see a transient 0.8% 5xx on shard-b (not shard-a). Correlating logs now.
maya: Pause ramp. I'm flipping off new_prompt_cache for shard-b only: `ffctl set --env prod --flag new_prompt_cache --targets shard-b --pct 0`
devon: Confirmed shard-b back to 0%. shard-a still 5%. Monitoring logs for root cause.
release-eng: Can we pin v2.1.4 for shard-b until we sort this? Ops: config change to pin model-version for shard-b: `svcctl set shard-b model_version=v2.1.4`
ops-bot: Model pin applied to shard-b.
sre_jordan: After pin and flag isolation, 5xxs have dropped to baseline. p95 normal. Recommend continue to 25% on shard-a-only path.
maya: Agree. Ramp plan revised: shard-a -> 25% then evaluate global 25% split across shards with pin on shard-b.
devon: Kicking 25% now for shard-a: `ffctl set --env prod --flag new_prompt_cache --targets shard-a --pct 25`
deploy-bot: Canary to 25% launched. Notifying oncall if thresholds breach.
sre_jordan: Watchdog note: if any shard crosses error threshold, we auto-run `ffctl set --env prod --flag new_prompt_cache --pct 0` and open incident.
maya: Also adding manual check: if generate latency > 150ms for 5m, we rollback.
release-eng: Post-deploy tasks: update changelog, notify customers on next status digest, and file a quick incident retro if rollback occurs.
ops-bot: Reminder: change window closes at 22:00 UTC. Any rollbacks after that require oncall approval.
maya: Understood. I'll keep monitoring. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
devon: Thanks — will follow up with short postmortem note if anything odd appears.
deploy-bot: Rollout progressing. Next checkpoint in 15m.
